Unbalanced braces: {{foo|bar and {{{arg|no close
Nested deep: {{a|{{b|{{c|{{d|e}}}}}}}}
Apostrophe jungle: '''''bold italic''' still italic'' and normal.
Odd bold: a'''b''c'''d and I'''m sure.
Quintuple close }}}}} and open {{{{{ mixed.
Wikilink with pipes: [[File:X.png|thumb|right|A ''caption'' with [[Link]] inside]]
External bare: [https://example.com] and [ftp://host/path label text].
Mismatched tags: <ref>open with no close and <b>bold</b> <br/> <div class="x>weird">z</div>
Extension raw: <nowiki>{{not a template}} '''not bold'''</nowiki> after.
Entities: &amp; &#160; &#x1F600; &notanentity &bad
Heading-ish but not: == inline == text on the same line.
=== Real heading with surplus ==
Table markup, with a nested table and a wikilink pipe in a cell:
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Header
| Cell {{tmpl}} value || [[Foo|Bar]]
|-
| nested:
{|
| inner
|}
|}
Bare URLs jammed against punctuation and existing link syntax: see (http://example.com/Foo_(bar)), http://example.com., and [http://example.com not-double-linked] http://example.com bare.
